Thanks. **Second question:** Do you have any fever or chills (measured temperature if you know it)?
I’m not sure. I don’t know my temperature, and I don’t clearly remember chills.
Understood. **Third question:** Have you noticed any sores or ulcers in your mouth or on your genital area (open blisters/ulcers), or is it mainly redness and pain?

Thank you. **Fourth question:** Are the mouth and genital lesions **vesicles/blisters** (fluid-filled) or **ulcers** (open sores with a crater/white/yellow center), or do they look more like **rash/skin irritation**?

**1) How old is the patient, and is the stridor mainly on inhalation (when breathing in), or also on exhalation (when breathing out)?**
I’m 42 years old. The stridor seems mainly on inhalation—when I breathe in.

Thanks.  

**2) When did the stridor start relative to the cold—did it begin during the cold, right after it ended, or several days later?**
It started during my cold, not right after it ended.
**3) Do you have any trouble breathing or feeling like you can’t get enough air—at rest or only when you exert yourself?**
Yes—at rest I feel like it’s harder to get enough air, not only with exertion.
**4) Are you able to speak full sentences, or are you short of breath to the point you can only speak in short phrases?**
I can speak full sentences, but it feels difficult because of the breathing sound.
**5) Any fever, drooling, or trouble swallowing (painful or difficulty getting food/liquid down)?**
No fever. I don’t have drooling. I don’t have trouble swallowing or pain when swallowing.
**6) Any recent exposure to a new medication or substance (especially ACE inhibitors like lisinopril, or recent NSAID use), or any known allergies?**
I’m not sure. I don’t know about new medications or allergies, and I haven’t paid close attention to recent NSAID use.
**7) Do you take an ACE inhibitor for blood pressure (names like lisinopril, enalapril, ramipril), or have you started one recently?**
I’m not sure. I don’t know if I’m on an ACE inhibitor.
**8) Do you have a history of asthma, COPD, or prior episodes of wheezing/stridor?**
I don’t know. I don’t have a clear history of asthma or COPD that I can recall. I haven’t had episodes like this before, as far as I know.
**9) Any neck symptoms—sore throat, hoarseness/voice change, or a “lump” sensation in the throat?**
Yes, my voice feels hoarse and I feel a lump or tightness in my throat.
**10) Have you had any cough, and if so is it barking/“seal-like,” or more like a typical cold cough?**
I have a cough, but it’s more like a typical cold cough—not a barking or seal-like cough.
**11) Any recent vomiting/acid reflux symptoms (heartburn, sour taste), or did symptoms worsen after lying down?**
Yes, I have gastroesophageal reflux. I’ve had some heartburn and a sour taste, and it does seem worse after lying down.
**12) Any history of smoking or significant environmental exposures (smoke, fumes), or known thyroid/neck masses?**
I don’t smoke myself, but I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily. I don’t know about any thyroid problems or neck masses.
**13) Any recent trauma or procedures to the airway (intubation, endoscopy), or inhalation of a foreign body?**
No recent trauma or airway procedures. No foreign body that I know of.
**14) Do you have any symptoms of infection elsewhere—like severe sore throat, ear pain, or swollen glands in the neck?**
I don’t know. I had the cold recently, but I can’t say about severe sore throat, ear pain, or swollen glands.
**15) Are you having any “muffled” voice, inability to open your mouth well, or worsening one-sided throat pain?**
I don’t know about one-sided throat pain. I do have hoarseness, and my throat feels tight, but I don’t know about muffled voice or trouble opening my mouth.
**16) Any stridor that is worse when lying flat, or does it improve when you sit up?**
It seems worse when I lie flat, and it improves when I sit up.
**17) Any history of anxiety/panic episodes that correlate with breathing symptoms, or do you feel the breathing difficulty is purely physical?**
I’m not sure. I don’t know if it’s anxiety-related, but I feel the breathing problem is physical.
**18) Have you noticed any swelling of the lips/tongue/face, hives, or itching?**
No swelling of the lips, tongue, or face. No hives and no itching.
**19) Do you have any chest pain, leg swelling, or recent long travel/immobility that could suggest a blood clot?**
No chest pain. No leg swelling. No recent long travel or immobility.
